title: Resolutive Science: Post-Falsification Diagnostic Release
description: Resolutive Science v0.4.0 is a post-falsification diagnostic negative release. It preserves the frozen v0.3 RCMS surrogate and adds Protocols 17–20, which find diffuse residual structure, survey-specific channel tension, no redshift-locality evidence, and exact-redshift DESI/BOSS discordance. The preregistered decision is DIAGNOSTIC_STOP_NO_EXTENSION. The release also preserves the fundamental reconstruction audit of the old RSMS formulation: the current Master Equation is not uniquely derived, the audited 4pi half-angle behavior is parametrization-only, and principle-selector tests P-A through P-E remain underdetermined. No discovery or experimental-validation claim is made.
